postings.title: Electrical Engineer, Signal Processing & Analog Circuits (Python, Network Analyzer / S-Parameters) | Cupertino, CA | W2
top_requirements: Design, simulate, and validate analog RF front‑end circuits using network analyzers and S‑parameter measurements.
Develop and implement signal‑processing algorithms in Python for modulation/demodulation and filter design.
Perform hands‑on laboratory bring‑up, debugging, and performance characterization of prototype boards.
postings.summary: The role focuses on analog circuit and signal‑processing development for communication hardware, matching the candidate's RF and modem background. It offers hands‑on design work in a well‑compensated contract position.

postings.title: Electrical Engineer, Signal Processing & Analog Circuits

postings.summary: An early‑career focused role that still requires solid analog and signal‑processing expertise, aligning with the candidate’s core skills. Compensation is below target but the work is directly technical.

postings.title: Systems Algorithm Engineer

postings.title: DSP Engineer

postings.summary: The DSP Engineer position directly involves algorithm development and hardware integration for communication audio products, aligning tightly with the candidate’s signal‑processing and modem background.
